# Alert pipeline from ingestion to processing

[Context map](../map.md)

How an alert travels: v1/v2/Grafana admission, Kafka publication, source processing with replay proof, then changed events.

## Ask like

- How does an alert get from ingestion to the processor?
- What does the processor do on replay?
- When does ingestion acknowledge a delivery?
